eligibility.base_reference_status: computed reference set, NOT verified exhaustive set of RW physical bases
eligibility.rounding_issue: Current CSV rounds km before filter; near-boundary cases require unrounded distance. No current candidate near 500 km.
alternative_reference_sensitivity: ZIA+SVX, reflecting case resources; calculate separately, do not overwrite primary
expanded actual bases only after same-date physical resource verification for all cities

requirements: certified airport and runway/performance for exact aircraft and operations
slots/opening hours compatible with proposed wave
MCT, passenger/baggage transfer and protected sale arrangements
SSJ maintenance access with required approval, capacity and contract
resources and launch permissions for project

strict_new.label: Строго новый узел (сценарная классификация)
strict_new.policy: Exclude all airports with same-date primary evidence of RW support/base status from strict-new shortlist, keep visible in expansion table. Apply symmetrically, not only to KUF.
strict_new.unknown_rw_status: conditional; never interpret missing or current encoded zero as verified new
strict_new.not_claimed: Support label does not prove physical base or working connecting hub.

expansion_allowed.label: Новый трансферный проект или расширение опорного аэропорта
expansion_allowed.baseline: Compare incremental project against continued existing RW service and expansion using same resources; no new financial calculation here.

required_evidence: dated RW/airport wording and geography of support/base status
overnight aircraft, assigned fleet, crews and actual base resources
maintenance scope, contract and available capacity
actual banked timetable, protected connections, MCT and through baggage
existing RW service/resource counterfactual and project increment

normalization.reference_universe: all 20 cities in source criteria.json, before eligibility and before mode/profile choice
normalization.continuous_bounds: lo/hi numeric in recommended_weights.csv, frozen observed extrema; transparent comparative anchors, NOT business thresholds
normalization.constant_column: utility=0.5 for every city, including observed; do not reward constancy
normalization.continuous_csv_fill_semantics: blank means normalized utility 0.5, NOT raw zero or missing row
normalization.discrete_csv_fill: raw midpoint, yields normalized utility 0.5; preserve unknown mask
normalization.if_new_data_outside_bounds: clip and flag; explicit scale version update for all scenarios together

evidence.never: Do not encode evidence confidence as physical degree or multiply score/weight by coverage. More documentation is not an independent benefit.

competitor_hub.legacy_0.75: secondary assertion => INDIRECT; central utility .5, range [0,1] until primary verification

ssj_mro.legacy_0.5: operator presence => INDIRECT; do not treat as half a station; central .5, range [0,1]
ssj_mro.confirmed_1: published operational maintenance capability for matching type; availability/contract still gate unknown

rostec_link.not_found: recode legacy zero from unsuccessful search to UNKNOWN; score weight stays 0

rw_support.not_found: recode unsupported legacy zero to UNKNOWN for mode eligibility; absence of wording is not proof of new base

evidence.transfer_zone: Check domestic/international scope and date; out-of-scope evidence becomes UNKNOWN, not false.

uncertainty.missing: central normalized .5; utility [0,1]; keep original missing/indirect mask even after imputation
uncertainty.ranks: best=1+count(other.low>own.high); worst=1+count(other.high>own.low); report ties at top3 boundary, not arbitrary certainty
uncertainty.interpretation: bounding scenarios, NOT confidence intervals or probabilities; independent corners may be jointly infeasible
uncertainty.coverage: report unknown and indirect weighted shares separately, no bonus/penalty in central score

gap_pop.central: midpoint of raw bounds; transform with frozen bounds
gap_pop.status: UNKNOWN rail component; not measured missing service; closed destinations already separated

uncertainty.partial_wage_coverage: Report wage_pop_coverage; conservative sensitivity assigns full utility [0,1] to coverage<1; no invented raw wage values. Central remains observed covered mean, explicitly proxy, not full-area estimate.
uncertainty.population_imputation: Report coordinate/regional-factor imputed shares; if >0, full utility [0,1] conservative sensitivity, no estimated probability. Central published estimate retained.
uncertainty.pax_lower_bound_qualifier: For >N use utility [utility(N),1], midpoint for central utility; no fabricated exact raw value.
uncertainty.transfer_model: Run cautious/base/optimistic source outputs if available; otherwise full [0,1] model sensitivity rather than claim exact estimate. Do not treat model error 50–56% as a valid confidence band.
uncertainty.weather_kover: Historical counts remain observed proxy; separately flag missing reporting/station coverage; no conversion to future delay probability.

anti_access_bias.mandatory: Report evidence_neutral profile alongside balanced under identical eligibility. Also common-neutral stress: set competitor_hub, ssj_mro, transfer_zone utility=.5 for ALL cities. Do not silently set all unknown to zero.
anti_access_bias.reason: Neutral midpoint alone does not remove advantage from asymmetric source discovery; show whether top3 survives removal of documentation-sensitive utility.

required_recalculation: Read all 18 criteria and all 100-point profiles; import CSV metadata or preserve short/fmt/board for existing build_criteria.
Recode legacy evidence levels and unsupported zero values with persistent uncertainty masks.
Use frozen bounds for Python and browser; handle all-constant columns as .5; clip values.
Implement interval/qualified-value handling, not only NaN detection; current score code does not consume these rules.
Produce profiles x {strict_new,expansion_allowed} with primary 500km; no-filter only separately labelled sensitivity.
Show current legacy top3 beside recomputed top3 and reasons for membership change; report ties, bounds and common-neutral stress.
Validate all profiles sum to 100, unknown midpoint and bounds, same Python/panel scores, unchanged primary eligibility.
Update stale docs/scenario claims after recalculation.
